contracts.ownerAlivePhase2Contract: Unverified platforms refuse instead of answering. A phase2 adapter must provide a conservative identity distinction (verified same-incarnation death vs alive-but-unverified vs unknown) before any boolean answer is issued; only a verified same-incarnation death may release a historical lock, budget slot or writer, and no answer is descendant proof without the verified reaping engines.
